reuse.why: It does reuse getApproxNumberThreshold, but adds no shared amount helper and leaves getScheduledAmount and the other amount sites untouched, so the new rule is pasted inline at each site it reaches.

duplication.why: The same `op === 'isapprox' ? v + Math.sign(v || 1) * getApproxNumberThreshold(v) : v` expression is pasted into api-models.ts, forecast-schedules.ts and computeSchedulePreviewTransactions, nested inside already-copied ternary dispatches.

placement.why: The planning rule is spread through an API model mapper, the forecast normaliser and the preview code instead of living in one shared schedule-amount function in shared/schedules.ts.

scope.why: Only amount resolution sites and their tests are touched.

maintainability.why: Three nested-ternary copies, while updateActions, postTransactionForSchedule, schedule-template and the client's getScheduledAmount still apply the old rule, guarantee divergence on the next change.

bypasses_abstraction.where: api-models.ts scheduleModel.toExternal, forecast-schedules.ts normalizeSchedule and shared/schedules.ts computeSchedulePreviewTransactions compute the amount inline rather than through getScheduledAmount or a shared helper.

disguised_duplication.where: The approximate-amount expression is copied verbatim in three files, not disguised.

one_place.where: The rule is written separately in api-models.ts, forecast-schedules.ts and computeSchedulePreviewTransactions; schedules/app.ts (updateActions, postTransactionForSchedule), budget/schedule-template.ts and getScheduledAmount are not changed.
